                "total_meeting": sum(me["end"] - me["start"] for me in schedule),
                "end_time": schedule[-1]["end"] if schedule else current_time,
                "schedule": list(schedule)
            }

        # Try each remaining person as next
        # Heuristic: try in order of earliest end time to find good solutions early
        for p in sorted(remaining, key=lambda x: x["end_min"]):
            # Check travel time availability
            travel_time = travel[current_loc].get(p["location"])

                continue  # no path (shouldn't happen)

            arrival = current_time + travel_time
            # Earliest we can start meeting (wait if early)
            meet_start = max(arrival, p["start_min"])
            meet_end = meet_start + p["min"]
            if meet_end <= p["end_min"]:
                # Feasible, proceed

                    "person": p["name"],

                    "end": meet_end
                }

                schedule.append(sched_entry)
                dfs(meet_end, p["location"], new_remaining, schedule)
                schedule.pop()
            else:

    dfs(start_time, start_location, candidates_sorted, [])

    # Prepare JSON output
    itinerary = []
